Melbourne Man Jailed for Enslaving and Assaulting Woman

Chee Kit Chong has been sentenced to four years in prison in Melbourne for intentionally keeping a woman, identified as being in her 60s and of Indonesian origin, as a slave. He was also found guilty of assault for his treatment of the victim. The court case concluded with his conviction and sentencing.
